ex_vivo_detail: Peptide stability assay in human plasma obtained from the UW-Madison Hospital Blood Bank: SSTNIGF1R and GRGDSP incubated at 37 C for 0, 8, 24 or 72 hr, then residual activity measured in a HUVEC adhesion assay. The body also states equivalent stability in mouse or bovine serum (animal-derived) but flags those data as not shown.
in_vitro_detail: Cell-culture growth, viability, caspase-3/7, TUNEL, immunoprecipitation, siRNA knockdown and antibody-array experiments in CAG, RPMI-8226, U266, MM.1R, KMS-12-BM and P3X63Ag8 myeloma cells, HUVEC and HMEC-1 endothelial cells, carcinoma lines and non-transformed HaCaT/MCF10A cells.

concentration_time_figure.locator: Fig. 6B (also Fig. 6A ex vivo % activity vs time, Fig. 6C steady-state accumulation vs time)
concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Stability of biotinylated SSTNIGF1R in the serum of mice following intravenous injection of a single bolus of peptide (0.365 mg/kg)
concentration_time_figure.note: Fig. 6B plots serum concentration of biotinylated SSTNIGF1R versus time (0-24 h) after a single i.v. bolus. Fig. 6A is an ex vivo human-plasma stability curve plotting retained activity versus incubation time (0-72 h), and Fig. 6C plots serum accumulation versus time over repeated daily s.c. dosing.

bioanalytical_method: Serum spotted on nitrocellulose and quantified by infrared scanning with an anti-biotin antibody on a LI-COR Odyssey imaging system (Image Studio v4.0); PK/PD parameters computed in WinNonlin, Phoenix 64
bioanalytical_quote: Levels of SSTNIGF1R in serum samples spotted on nitrocellulose membranes were quantified by IR scanning using anti-biotin antibody on a LI-COR Biosciences Odyssey digital imaging system
notes: Route discrepancy in the source: the Methods describe the single-bolus PK arm without naming a route ('mice were given a single bolus'), while the Results text and the Fig. 6B caption both state the 27 h half-life came from a single INTRAVENOUS injection; the serial 24-hourly dosing was subcutaneous. Only the biotinylated peptide has PK data; no half-life, Cmax or tmax is reported for SSTNIGF1R-T or for the pump-delivered unlabelled peptide. Half-life values are reported without error terms, and the n = 3 mice/condition figure comes from the serial-injection description. No amino-acid sequence for SSTNIGF1R or SSTNIGF1R-T appears in the body.
